summary: Verified one-time fee bug fix on backend. Created deterministic setup (fresh class ONETIME-TEST + student + Tuition OT 10000 monthly + Admission OT 2000 one_time_month=9) via super_admin, POSTed the plan (assigned_students=1), and validated /api/fees/student/{id}/fee-schedule + /api/fees/student/{id}/dues. Result matches spec: Sept (9) amount=3000, normal collection months=1000 each, June (6) & March (3)=0 with status='no_fee', sum of active months=12000, dues total_expected=12000, and one-time 2000 appears only in September (no other month inflated). Auto-assignment via _sync_plan_assignments propagated the plan installments to the student's FeeAssignment correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: _build_plan_installments correctly separates one_time from recurring items and adds one-time in full to its target month with fallback to first collection month if invalid/missing.
_sync_plan_assignments repoints existing student assignments to the plan and replaces installments so schedule/dues stay in sync with plan edits.
seed_data_creation: Created fresh class 'ONETIME-TEST' section A, one student 'One Time Test', two fee heads 'Tuition OT' & 'Admission OT', and plan 'OneTime Test Plan' under the first (Stanvard) school. Non-destructive to existing seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression test at /app/backend/tests/test_onetime_fee.py covers the one-time fee flow end-to-end (plan create -> auto-assign -> student schedule -> dues). Schedule rows use status values 'overdue'/'pending'/'no_fee' (not 'active'); sum of amount>0 rows is the reliable annual total. Fee schedule endpoint returns {'schedule': [...]} with month/year/amount/status/label.
rca of the issue: N/A - fix verified. Root cause (pre-fix) was that one-time items were flowing through the equal-split path; the fix separates one_time items and adds their full amount to plan.item.one_time_month (fallback: first collection month), then sums with recurring net for that month.
